_readme: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the Contracts CI forge-test matrix.
`.github/workflows/contracts-ci.yml` builds its matrix from this file via
`scripts/check-test-slice-coverage.mjs --emit-matrix`, and the SAME script
asserts that every contracts/test/**/*.t.sol is claimed by exactly one slice
or by an explicit `excluded` entry. Keeping the patterns here (rather than
inline in the workflow) is deliberate: a guard that carries its own private
copy of the pattern list can pass while the matrix runs nothing.
`pattern` is a GLOB, not a regex — it is passed verbatim to
`forge test --match-path`. Two rules bite constantly:
* `*` does NOT cross `/`. `test/*.t.sol` reaches no subdirectory of test/.
* regex syntax (`|`, `$`, `\.`) is matched LITERALLY and silently finds
nothing, because forge exits 0 on 'No tests found in project!'.
`noMatchTest` is the shared `--no-match-test` regex applied to every slice.
It filters by TEST NAME, so any test whose name contains Fuzz/Invariant is
skipped in PR-blocking CI regardless of which slice its file lands in.
A slice MAY override it with its own `noMatchTest` — the `invariants` slice
does, because the shared default would strip every test it exists to run.
The override is not a loophole: the per-slice guard asserts the slice still
yields >=1 runnable test UNDER ITS EFFECTIVE FILTER, so an override that
silences everything fails loudly instead of passing over nothing.

excluded.reason: Echidna property definitions (`echidna_*`). forge's collector only picks up `test*` / `invariant_*`, so `forge test` finds zero runnable tests in this directory no matter what pattern points at it. Requires the `echidna` binary, which is not installed in this workflow.
Halmos symbolic specs (`check_*`). Same story as echidna: forge collects zero tests from these files. Requires the `halmos` binary, which is not installed in this workflow.
